assembly_and_founder_rules.post_abort_joint_replacement: (4) POST-ABORT RULE (founder rule, lead 248 (7)): after any case-TC or TB-state abort the J-FWD joint counts as used: the ten ENG-HW-101-IN718 screws and their HW-170 springs are replaced (new, single-use) and the TC-01 holes (pins GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62) and the TC-02 taps (M5-6H GO / NO-GO) are gauged before the next run; this stands beside the 60 bar abs rule of the LC-TB70 envelope (lc_tb70_envelope_v1.json, unchanged: 'any head excursion above 60.0 bar abs: replace all J-FWD screws (HW-101) and gauge the TC-01 holes / TC-02 taps before the next run', the line-231 inspect-or-replace rule in head-trace form). Reason: the post-abort soak (ASSUMED shifted history, J-FWD band up to 201.4 C GVLO / 164.0 C GVHI, jf1b_loctite_v352_v1.json) is not a rows or J-F1b state. OPEN (lead CHANGELOG 253 (8), (10); Mechanical's next round, not this re-map): the TB-state aborts are HW_OVERPRESSURE, PC_OVERPRESSURE and HARD_START by the lead's PROVISIONAL definition (the case-TC OVER_TEMP abort is in F-14), Mechanical to confirm; the 60 bar abs rule is a head-trace threshold, not an abort type, so as written a normal light whose head peak exceeds 60 bar abs also triggers it (above 58.1 bar abs the LC-TB70 envelope has only the abnormal bases: Z2 SF 1.0 / 1.5, Z3 FA-1 SF 1.0); 185 of 896 FA-1 grid head peaks exceed 60 bar abs [SIM grid fraction, not a probability]; whether the rule stands for normal lights stays OPEN until REV-COMB-4 says whether those peaks are physical; Electronics states the logged quantity and threshold that detect it.
assembly_and_founder_rules.J-F1b: J-F1b (the optional J-F1 extension of hardware v1.7 HW-101; rule lead 19:53:27Z, PEAK 175 C ACCEPTED 21:17:03Z, dwell CORRECTED, CHANGELOG 248 (7); work-tree record jf1b_loctite_v352_v1.json 2ba9d10745f3f651, read-only [SIM]): 5 of the J-F1 joints (with the spring, the load washer kept in; J-F1 coupons, never flight hardware), the cycle 20 -> 175 C -> 20 C, at least 10 min at the peak from when the spring flat reaches the peak, 10 cycles as in hardware v1.7, residual preload and breakaway torque recorded after each cycle as data for the preload-retention audit (the check on the relaxation model). Peak 175 C = max(160 C, the governing SOAK70 zone maximum 160.29 C + 10 C) rounded up to 5 C (the js5 screw set alone gives 170 C, information); the 10 min is more than ten times the governing state's 53.0 s above (zone maximum - 10 C). METHOD: a uniform oven cycle puts the tap LOCTITE 243 at 175 C against 97.7 C in service, so it is allowed only once Henkel's service range for 243 is verified to cover 175 C (AS RECALLED -55 to +180 C, TO-VERIFY); otherwise the spring and head zone are heated locally and the tap temperature is recorded; TO-DEFINE by the test owner (founder). The post-abort soak is not a J-F1b state (C9 (4)).
